name: 71923 · Arkadelphia, AR
findings: ZIP 71923 (Arkadelphia) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71923 (Arkadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 71923 (Arkadelphia) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
